# Orbit

> A cockpit for the agents that write your code. Orbit is a terminal cockpit
> for coding agents: each task runs in its own git worktree, in phases that
> stop where you tell them to, and everything is written down — the plan, the
> prompts, the reasoning, the diff, the cost, what the agent refused to do.

Orbit never calls a model. It runs the coding-agent CLI you already have
installed — Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Antigravity — under the subscription you already
pay for, so there is no API key and no second bill per token. It is an MCP
server with 22 tools, so your CLI writes the tasks, runs them, reads back
everything that happened while you were away, and teaches Orbit what it worked
out.

Built by Elio Rincón ([e1i0.com](https://e1i0.com)).

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/e1i0r/orbit#readme): what it is, install, and the ten flows
- [Getting started](https://github.com/e1i0r/orbit/blob/main/docs/start.md): install, the MCP server, the first task
- [What you can do](https://github.com/e1i0r/orbit/blob/main/docs/menus.md): the menu on anything, including what it refuses and why
- [A run, end to end](https://github.com/e1i0r/orbit/blob/main/docs/run.md): flows, phases and gates
- [Autopilot](https://github.com/e1i0r/orbit/blob/main/docs/autopilot.md): the queue working itself, and the unread cap that brakes it
- [Many tasks at once](https://github.com/e1i0r/orbit/blob/main/docs/parallel.md): a worktree each, running side by side
- [Reading what it did](https://github.com/e1i0r/orbit/blob/main/docs/reading.md): the report, the diff, and the impact of a change
- [The CLI, both ways](https://github.com/e1i0r/orbit/blob/main/docs/cli.md): handing the terminal over, and the MCP tools
- [The supervisor](https://github.com/e1i0r/orbit/blob/main/docs/supervisor.md): the second pair of eyes and the thread you steer it in
- [What Orbit knows](https://github.com/e1i0r/orbit/blob/main/docs/knowledge.md): facts with a source and a reach, kept outside the model
- [Flows you write yourself](https://github.com/e1i0r/orbit/blob/main/docs/flows.md): a list of phases, each with its own engine, prompt and permissions
- [Engines](https://github.com/e1i0r/orbit/blob/main/docs/engines.md): the model and reasoning catalogue of each CLI
- [Cockpit](https://github.com/e1i0r/orbit/blob/main/docs/cockpit.md): bands, tabs and keybindings
- [Install script](https://getorbit.sh/install.sh): `curl -fsSL https://getorbit.sh/install.sh | bash`
- [Contributing guide](https://github.com/e1i0r/orbit/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): how to build the project and send a pull request
- [License](https://github.com/e1i0r/orbit/blob/main/LICENSE): Apache License 2.0
